label: late original-phase / <DEL> steps in sequences starting with h or b (strongest on q)
explanation: Sparse feature that fires only in the last few original-phase steps (t=5..9, orig_idx 5-8; about 80% of mass) and on the <DEL> step (about 20%). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<4. About 75% of mass comes from sequences whose first token is h or b. The strongest activations are on input q late in the sequence (q is the input on 52% of mass, lift 13x; top examples reach about 1.0 of max on q right before <DEL>). Activation also goes up when the prefix has several of x, s, v, c, n. The context conditions are necessary but not sufficient: most late q tokens in h/b sequences stay silent, so the feature seems to read a specific combination in the hidden state that these variables only approximate. Best dev F1 is about 0.19 (precision 0.14, recall 0.32). Adding in_tok==q gives precision 0.57 but recall 0.08. Does not fire on copy-phase steps, on early original positions, or on short sequences (L<=4).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+5.67), orig0=h (+5.67), orig2=v (+4.01), prev_tok=n (+3.39), orig1=v (+3.35), orig1=s (+3.24). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.97), t=3 (-3.96), prev3_tok=- (-3.68), prev2_tok=b (-3.24).
